shattered-pixel-dungeon.description:
Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a free, open-source roguelike dungeon crawler RPG featuring turn-based combat, procedurally generated levels, and challenging strategic gameplay. Every adventure is different, with randomized enemies, equipment, traps, treasures, and dungeon layouts.

Choose from six distinct heroes, including the Warrior, Mage, Rogue, Huntress, Duelist, and Cleric. Each character offers unique talents, subclasses, and abilities that encourage different strategies and playstyles. Explore five dungeon regions, battle powerful bosses, collect hundreds of items, and experiment with magical equipment, alchemy, and enchantments.

The game includes over 25 dungeon floors, numerous enemy types, optional challenges, achievements, and an extensive in-game journal. Carefully manage your resources and adapt your tactics to survive, because death ends your current adventure.

Shattered Pixel Dungeon features detailed pixel art, an interface designed for both phones and larger screens, and support for many languages. It works offline for single-player gameplay and is regularly updated with new content and improvements.

Originally based on Pixel Dungeon by Watabou, Shattered Pixel Dungeon has evolved into a distinct open-source game under the GNU GPLv3.
